title_has_uw.details: Resource title in the metadata.json file still contains 'unfoldingWord'.
title_has_uw.suggestion: Edit the metadata.json file and remove 'unfoldingWord ' from the beginning of **`title`**, such as **`unfoldingWord® Literal Text`** => **`Literal Text`**, or translate into your language.

language_is_en.details: Language in the metadata.json file is still English **`en`**.
language_is_en.suggestion: Edit the metadata.json file and change **`en`** to the correct **`language code`** for your project's language, the **`title`** of the language, and the **`direction`**.
